title: Tensor projection formula for extension by zero on a ringed-site slice
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site, with $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and let $U\in\mathcal C$. Use the localized ringed site $(\mathcal C/U,\mathcal O_U)$ and restriction $\mathcal F|_U$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], and the categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define $j_{U!}\mathcal G=(P_{\mathcal G})^\#$, where $P_{\mathcal G}$ is the direct-sum extension-by-zero presheaf [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf] and $(-)^\#$ is module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. For every $\mathcal O_U$-module $\mathcal G$ and every $\mathcal O$-module $\mathcal F$, there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O$-modules, natural in both variables, $$j_{U!}(\mathcal G\otimes_{\mathcal O_U}\mathcal F|_U)\cong (j_{U!}\mathcal G)\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal F,$$ where the tensors are sheaf tensor products [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].
